description: Get full details on a single model portfolio: its underlying vault allocations, the live APY of each underlying vault, and the blended portfolio APY. Use this when the user asks about a specific portfolio like "what is in Core on Ethereum" or "how does Foundation on Base work".

portfolio.description: Portfolio ID or name. Examples: "foundation-eth", "Core Portfolio", "growth-eth", "Foundation Portfolio Base".

name: get_portfolio_details
